summary: Critical-section-guarded file read wrapper. Validates the slot index a1 against the global open-file count uNumber and checks the per-slot active flag bit (bit 0 of the byte at slot-table pointer + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4, where the slot table dword_8D4920 is indexed in 32-slot groups by a1>>5). On success enters the per-slot critical section, performs the read through sub_58CA19, leaves the critical section and returns the bytes read. On invalid/closed slot writes TLS error code 9 through TLSOffsetGetter, clears the TLS value written by TLSOffsetGetter_afd8, and returns -1. Structural twin of sub_58C331 (cluster_copy prelabel, DERIVED).

local_names.nNumberOfBytesToRead: maximum number of bytes to read

operations.description: Slot validity guard: a1 must be less than uNumber (global open-file count at 0x008D4A20)
Slot-active guard: bit 0 of the byte at dword_8D4920[a1>>5] + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4 must be non-zero; dword_8D4920 is a table of per-32-slot groups and the expression locates the flag byte for slot a1
CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit(a1) enters the per-slot critical section on the valid-slot path
v3 = sub_58CA19(a1, lpBuffer, nNumberOfBytesToRead) performs the actual read, forwarding the slot, buffer and byte count unchanged
FileCriticalSectionLeave(a1) releases the per-slot critical section
Return v3 (bytes read) on the valid-slot path
Error path: write TLS error code 9 through the pointer returned by TLSOffsetGetter()
Error path: clear the TLS value written through the pointer returned by TLSOffsetGetter_afd8() to 0
Return -1 on the invalid/closed-slot error path
Called from sub_58806E, sub_58C255 and sub_59C30E as a shared guarded file-read helper
